coverage: All 27 non-Magram quests in the current 38-entry zone index, plus five associated Desolace/Maraudon/Razorfen Downs handoffs or steps. Primary NPC quest starts/ends in area 16651 provide no additional candidate outside the checked set.
limits: Completeness is against the current published zone index and observed primary quest/NPC records, not proof that no undiscovered quest exists.
The earlier secondary zone export only lists 19 entries; it is insufficient as a complete current zone catalog.
Faction classification uses explicit Both factions labels on current pages. Historical unresolved/defaulted primary race masks alone do not prove shared access.
No class restriction or Magram minimum reputation is listed for the newly added shared quests in the inspected page/trace fields; missing fields are not claimed as measured server flags.
Questie relation traces explicitly describe assumptions based on observed handoffs. They are stored as previousQuests / Offered after, not mandatory prerequisites.
Some shared objectives mention both centaur clans. Mentioning Magram does not make a shared quest Magram-only.
Item-starting quests retain unknown pickup coordinates rather than borrowing a turn-in NPC position.
